verdict.rationale: A coding agent could plausibly offer a plugin or marketplace ecosystem for partner-built agent apps, so this axis applies. The evidence shows none. Aider's scripting API and --message mode let other tools embed Aider, and one partner (Dosu) says it is interested in doing that. That is the reverse direction, not Aider hosting third-party agent apps. The community 'navigator-mode' is a user-built extension, not a partner-app integration mechanism.
